authority_contract.key_material: Never loads or serializes keys; reads existing wallet.address only. Official original Signer retains its existing keys.
authority_contract.lock_key: Actual wallet address normalized lowercase, process-wide registry; role name is not the lock key.
authority_contract.scope: Original do(pay) entire execution, including authorization, nonce/broadcast/receipt wait, sent append and logging.
authority_contract.validation_order: Acquire address lock, then call unchanged super().do so capability validity/expiry/revocation, operation, role and amount limit are checked at execution time.
authority_contract.non_pay_operations: sign and sign_jwt directly call original do without the pay lock.
authority_contract.payload_stability: Copy primitive payment request fields before waiting; keep main role-wallet map stable.
authority_contract.exceptions: Context manager releases lock for exceptions; original SDK exception/result semantics remain.
authority_contract.repeated_factory_selection: Idempotent; already-adapted class is returned without nesting the same nonreentrant lock.
authority_contract.default: Usable by a future real main signer; no test-only bypass or automatic installation.

future_loader_injection.location: Pure host install(official) hook, after verify_kit and import of official agent_kit, before original official.cmd_run constructs the only shared Signer.
future_loader_injection.shared_instance: Keep the one original cmd_run-created ctx[signer] instance for stock and future refund Toolbox calls; never create a second refund signer or load keys from this module.
future_loader_injection.model_context: Inference-token-only context stays separate from tool context; this adapter does not expose or replace Model context.

preserved_limits: Process-local locks do not coordinate another process or another non-adapted signer.
A capability revoked after original do has already authorized an in-flight payment cannot cancel that payment.
Original sent list is appended only after maroo.pay returns; revoke while in flight can return an empty sent list despite a later successful/mock broadcast.
Timeout/broadcast uncertainty is not resolved by this lock. Durable pre-send intent, nonce/chain anchor, unknown state and no-resend recovery still belong to business tools.
No refund policy, send tool, price logic or receipt publisher is implemented.
